article_content: A growing number of American expatriates are choosing to give up their U.S. passports as new government regulations aim to crack down on tax evaders. The trend of Americans renouncing their citizenship remains close to record levels, with 1,577 individuals doing so in the first half of this year, according to data from the Federal Register. This marks only the second time since 1998 that the number has exceeded 1,500. Stricter asset disclosure rules under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (Fatca) took effect on July 1, compelling foreign banks, including those in Switzerland, to share data on their American clients with the U.S. government. Over 100 Swiss banks are now providing information to avoid legal consequences, which led to 576 American expats renouncing their citizenship in the second quarter. Matthew Ledvina, a U.S. tax lawyer at Anaford AG in Zurich, commented to Bloomberg, 'Fatca and the Swiss bank disclosure program have significantly intensified the search for U.S. nationals. The levels of due diligence they are going through to ensure compliance are astonishing.' The United States stands alone among OECD nations in taxing its citizens regardless of where they reside. This policy makes renouncing citizenship an appealing option for expats seeking to avoid higher U.S. tax rates. Nearly 9,000 Americans have given up their citizenship in the past five years, although this year's figures show a 13% decrease compared to the same period last year, they remain historically high. Before 2010, the number of Americans renouncing their citizenship rarely surpassed 200 per quarter. However, in the first quarter of 2014, it reached 1,001. The U.S. government's intensified efforts against tax evaders began in 2009 when UBS AG was fined $780 million and compelled to disclose data on 4,700 accounts. A survey by the deVere Group in Zurich last November suggested that the trend of Americans renouncing their citizenship may continue. Of 400 expatriates surveyed, more than two-thirds had considered giving up their U.S. citizenship. It is estimated that around six million Americans currently live abroad. Swiss banks are now reviewing records dating back to the 1990s to identify any American clients, including those with U.S. addresses or phone numbers. Individuals found are either asked to leave the bank or placed in separate sections where they will pay U.S. tax rates. Enacted in 2010, Fatca targets U.S. taxpayers using foreign bank accounts and not complying with U.S. tax laws. It requires banks to report information to the IRS about accounts held by U.S. taxpayers or foreign entities with substantial U.S. ownership. Additionally, it imposes a 30% withholding tax on payments to non-compliant foreign banks. Fatca enables the U.S. government to access data from over 77,000 institutions and 80 governments about its citizens' financial activities abroad.

Halos 9,000 Amerikano ang tumalikwas sa kanilang pagkamamamayan sa nakaraang limang taon, bagaman nagpapakita ng 13% pagbaba ang mga numero ng taong ito kumpara sa parehong panahon ng nakaraang taon, nananatili pa rin silang mataas sa kasaysayan. Isang survey ng deVere Group sa Zurich noong Nobyembre nagmungkahi na maaaring magpatuloy ang trend ng mga Amerikanong tumatalikwas sa kanilang pagkamamamayan. Sa 400 expatriates na sinuri, higit sa dalawang-katlo ang naisip na iwanan ang kanilang pagkamamamayan sa US. Tinatayang mahigit anim na milyong Amerikano ang kasalukuyang naninirahan sa ibang bansa. Ngayon ay binabalik ng mga Swiss banks ang mga talaan mula pa noong 1990s upang matukoy ang anumang Amerikanong kliyente, kasama ang mga may address o numero ng telepono sa US. Ang mga natagpuan ay hinihiling na umalis sa bangko o inilalagay sa hiwalay na seksyon kung saan sila magbabayad ng mga rate ng buwis sa US. Ipinasa noong 2010, ang Fatca ay tinatalabanan ang mga tagabuwis ng US na gumagamit ng dayuhang accounts sa bangko at hindi sumusunod sa mga batas pang-buwis sa US. Nakikilahok ito sa mga bangko na mag-ulat ng impormasyon sa IRS tungkol sa mga accounts na hawak ng mga tagabuwis ng US o dayuhang entidad na may malaking pagmamay-ari sa US. Dagdag pa rito, nagpapataw ito ng 30% withholding tax sa mga bayad sa mga dayuhang bangko na hindi sumusunod. Pinapayagan ng Fatca ang gobyerno ng US na makakuha ng data mula sa higit sa 77,000 institusyon at 80 gobyerno tungkol sa pampinansyal na gawain ng kanilang mga mamamayan sa ibang bansa.

article_content: Roberto Soldado added another disappointing performance to his record as Tottenham exited the Europa League. With a clear path to goal, Soldado had multiple options: he could have rounded the goalkeeper, taken a shot, or passed to Nacer Chadli for an easy tap-in. Any of these choices would have given Spurs the lead. Instead, he inexplicably passed the ball directly to the goalkeeper, Neto, while trying to find Chadli. Mario Gomez scored the opening goal for Fiorentina in the second half, skillfully nutmegging Tottenham's goalkeeper and captain, Hugo Lloris. Teammate Joaquin celebrated enthusiastically by jumping on Gomez's back. Later, Mohamed Salah doubled Fiorentina's lead following a defensive blunder by Tottenham. Salah, who was visibly excited, was booked for removing his shirt during the celebration. The Fiorentina players were jubilant after securing their victory. Fiorentina's lineup included Neto, Richards, Savic, Basanta, Alonso, Badeji, Fernandez, Pizarro, Joaquin, Salah, and Gomez. Substitutes included Rodriguez, Aquilani, and Pasqual. Goals were scored by Gomez and Salah, with Badeji and Salah receiving yellow cards. The team was managed by Vincenzo Montella. Tottenham's lineup featured Lloris, Chiriches, Fazio, Vertonghen, Davies, Bentaleb, Stambouli, Chadli, Eriksen, Lamela, and Soldado. Substitutes included Kane, Walker, and Townsend. Davies received a yellow card. The team was managed by Mauricio Pochettino. The referee for the match was Huseyin Gocek from Turkey, and the attendance was 29,886. Mohamed Salah was named Man of the Match. Soldado's mistake was a significant talking point, trending on Twitter even above Madonna's slip at the Brit Awards. Had Soldado capitalized on his opportunity, Tottenham might still be in the Europa League. However, Soldado wasn't solely to blame; Jan Vertonghen also shared responsibility for the defensive lapses. Pochettino's team selection for the match hinted at his preparations for the upcoming Capital One Cup final against Chelsea. Key players like Harry Kane, Kyle Walker, Danny Rose, and Ryan Mason were benched, suggesting they would start at Wembley. Despite the loss, Pochettino's strategic decisions were notable, including the risky choice to start Christian Eriksen, who nearly secured a penalty early in the game. Replays showed Eriksen had a valid penalty claim, but it was not awarded. The match was intense from the start, with both teams creating chances. Tottenham looked determined to nullify Fiorentina's away goal advantage but ultimately fell short due to Soldado's missed opportunity and defensive errors. Harry Kane scored after coming on as a substitute, but his goal was correctly ruled out for offside. Micah Richards, on loan from Manchester City, had a rare start for Fiorentina and is rumored to be seeking a return to the Premier League. Mohamed Salah continued his impressive form against English teams, scoring his fifth goal in European competition, all against English sides. His performance was a highlight of the match. Fatigue may have been a factor for Tottenham, who have played more games than any other Premier League side this season. Historically, Tottenham has struggled to advance in European knockout rounds after failing to win the first leg at home, a trend that continued with this loss.

Parang determinadong mabawasan ng Tottenham ang advantage ng Fiorentina sa away goal ngunit sa wakas ay nahulog dahil sa nawalan ng pagkakataon ni Soldado at mga kamalian sa depensa. Rare start para kay Micah Richards, na on loan mula sa Manchester City, para sa Fiorentina at may balita na naghahanap ng pagbalik sa Premier League. Patuloy na nagpapakita ng impressive na porma laban sa mga English teams si Mohamed Salah, nakapuntos ng kanyang ikalimang goal sa European competition, lahat ay laban sa mga English sides. article_content: Click here to read Nasser Hussain's thoughts on the tragic death of Phillip Hughes and cricket's reaction. We’re all shocked by the news of Phillip Hughes’s death. Sport can be dangerous, but it’s not supposed to end like this. You just can’t make any sense out of it. I’m deeply saddened for Hughes’s family and friends, and for the entire Australian cricket community. I hope the feelings of the lad who bowled the ball, Sean Abbott, aren’t forgotten. I’m sure he won’t be – there’s a good support network around players these days. But it will be a hard thing for him to come back from. I remember the incident with Peter Lever and Ewen Chatfield during a Test in Auckland in 1975. It was at the end of an Ashes series in which me and the other England batsmen had taken a terrible pounding at the hands of Dennis Lillee and Jeff Thomson, and I’d gone home before the New Zealand leg of the tour. But Peter, who was a team-mate of mine at Lancashire, had hit Chatfield on the head in the days before helmets. Chatfield collapsed and swallowed his tongue. He had to be resuscitated by the England physio Bernie Thomas, who said his heart had briefly stopped beating. Technically, I suppose you could say he was dead for a few moments. Mercifully for everyone, Ewen pulled through, but I always felt Peter was never the same bowler after that. He was a thoughtful chap, and the fact that Chatfield came so close to dying was tough for him to deal with. This tragedy is just desperately sad for Hughes’s family and friends, and for the whole of Australian cricket. Abbott was warmly embraced by team-mates and cricketers at St Vincent's Hospital on Thursday. The Australian Cricketers' Association said they were monitoring Abbott and would offer support. Next summer during a county match, we were playing on an uncovered pitch – and Peter just didn’t want to bowl. No one blamed him. He was really suffering, and he still gets asked about it today. He’s still uncomfortable about it now – and Chatfield didn’t even pay the ultimate price. So just imagine how young Abbott must be feeling. You just hope he doesn’t blame himself. Batsmen have better protection these days, and I don’t see this as being an issue about the safety of helmets. It was just a freakish accident. But how, as a bowler, do you deal with something like this? How can you ever love the game again? My heart goes out to Sean Abbott.

Ito ay sa wakas ng isang Ashes series kung saan ako at ang iba pang England batsmen ay nabugbog ng husto sa kamay ni Dennis Lillee at Jeff Thomson, at umuwi ako bago ang New Zealand leg ng tour. Napakabuti para sa lahat, tinuloy ni Ewen, ngunit parati akong nararamdaman na hindi na siya parehong bowler pagkatapos noon. Isang masinop na tao siya, at ang katotohanang napakalapit na mamatay si Chatfield ay mahirap para sa kanya. Ang trahedya ay talagang nakakalungkot para sa pamilya at mga kaibigan ni Hughes, at para sa buong Australian cricket. Si Abbott ay mainit na yakap ng mga kakampi at cricketers sa St Vincent's Hospital nitong Huwebes. Sinabi ng Australian Cricketers' Association na pinagmamasdan nila si Abbott at magbibigay ng suporta. Susunod na tag-init sa isang county match, naglalaro kami sa isang hindi natakpan na pitch – at ayaw ni Peter na mag-bowl. Walang sinisisi sa kanya. Talagang nasasaktan siya, at patuloy siyang tinatanong tungkol dito ngayon. Hindi pa rin siya komportable tungkol dito ngayon – at hindi naman si Chatfield ang nagbayad ng pinakamataas na presyo. Kaya't isipin mo lang kung paano nararamdaman ni Abbott. Sana hindi niya isisisi ang kanyang sarili. Mas mabuti ang proteksyon ng mga batsmen ngayon, at hindi ko ito tingnan bilang isyu tungkol sa kaligtasan ng mga helmet. Ito ay isang aksidenteng kapritso. Pero paano, bilang isang bowler, mo harapin ang isang bagay tulad nito? Paano mo pa maaaring mahalin ang laro muli? Nasasaktan ako para kay Sean Abbott.

Ang mag-asawa, na may pitong buwan ang anak na lalaki na si Tennessee, ay binigyan ng bail hanggang sa kanilang pagdinig sa korte sa Mayo 22. Si Reese - na may mga anak na sina Ava, 13, at anak na lalaki na si Deacon, 10, kasama ang kanyang dating asawa na si Ryan Phillippe - ay gumawa ng pampublikong paghingi ng tawad para sa kanyang ugali. Ikaw ay nabook: Lumabas si Reese ng isang pahayag kung saan siya ay umamin na may 'isang drink na sobra.' Walang kamay na libre: Sumusunod si Reese sa pulis mula sa kotse na may kandado pa rin. Tungkol sa nakakainsultong mga komento sa mga awtoridad, na kinabibilangan ng sinasabing pahayag na 'makikilala mo kung sino ako,' sinabi niya: 'Dahil sa respeto sa patuloy na sitwasyong legal, hindi ako makakomento sa lahat ng tinutukoy ngayon. 'Pero gusto kong sabihin na malinaw na may isang drink na sobra at ako ay malalim na nahihiya tungkol sa mga bagay na sinabi ko. Nahuli sa camera: Ang Oscar-winning na aktres ay nahuli sa isang napakahiyang sandali sa CCTV. Disorderly: Sumunod si Jim Toth, ang asawa ni Reese, sa kanyang asawa sa isang ibang patrol car kung saan siya ay nabook din. 'Ito ay talagang isang nakakatakot na sitwasyon at ako ay natakot para sa aking asawa, pero wala itong dahilan. Ako ay nakakainsulto sa opisyal na gumagawa lang ng kanyang trabaho. 'Wala akong iba pang respeto para sa pulisya at ako ay lubos na nagpapakita ng tawad para sa aking ugali.' Samantala, ang kaibigan ni Reese na si Chelsea Handler ay sinabi sa Entertainment Tonight na ang aktres ay 'okay.' 'Siya ay sinusubukang protektahan ang kanyang asawa, kaya,' sinabi niya. 'I mean lahat ng tao ay gumagawa ng mga kamalian, kaya hindi ito isang malaking bagay.' Matapang na mukha: Si Reese at ang kanyang asawa ay lumipad patungong New York at nakita na maglamorous isang araw matapos silang arestuhin sa Georgia. Nagkita si Chelsea kay Reese, ang kanyang asawa, at isang grupo ng mga kaibigan kasama sina Cameron Diaz, Michael Keaton, Judd Apatow, at Leslie Mann - dalawang araw matapos ang pagkakahuli ng mag-asawa. Ayon sa Us Weekly, sumali ang mag-asawa sa kanilang mga kaibigan sa Greenwich Hotel sa New York City. Nagsimula si Reeseng mag-date kay Jim noong maagang Pebrero 2010, tatlong taon matapos ang kanyang diborsyo kay aktor na si Ryan Phillippe na may dalawang anak. Ikinasal sina Jim at Reese sa Ojai, California noong Marso 2011.

article_content: Cologne, Germany (CNN) -- Over 340,000 gamers from across Europe gathered in this charming German city last month to experience Sony's PlayStation 4 and Microsoft's Xbox One consoles firsthand and preview a variety of new games. The event was Gamescom, the colossal video gaming exhibition that drew more than 600 exhibitors from over 80 countries, all setting up booths in 10 enormous halls covering over 1.4 million square feet of space. It was akin to E3 and Comic-Con, but on a much grander scale. Major companies like Sony, Microsoft, Ubisoft, and Electronic Arts initiated the festivities with press conferences featuring exclusive announcements, such as the November 15 PS4 launch date and new titles like 'The Sims 4.' Europe holds a significant position in the global gaming ecosystem, thanks to successful European companies like Rovio Entertainment ('Angry Birds'), DICE ('Battlefield 4'), and TT Games ('The LEGO Movie Game'). According to Peter Warman, founder of video-game research firm Newzoo, European consumers will account for 23% of the $70.4 billion global video game market this year. 'The most discussed companies over the past year are European,' said Warman. 'Companies like SuperCell ('Clash of Clans'), Wargaming ('World of Tanks'), Mojang ('Minecraft'), and King ('Candy Crush') will generate a combined revenue exceeding $1.5 billion this year.' While next-generation gaming was a major focus, current consoles still have substantial longevity. The PC, traditionally strong in Europe, remains influential. Here are five standout games from the crowded booths of Gamescom 2013: 'Fighter Within' -- Ubisoft/Daoka; Xbox One; Fall 2013. Developer Daoka maximizes the new Xbox One Kinect technology with this fighting game, controlled by arm and leg movements. Enhanced motion sensors and tracking replicate players' moves accurately within the game. Players can select from various fighters, each with unique fighting styles and special moves. The game supports two-player competitive play, allowing friends to compete side by side in real life while battling virtually. 'The Sims 4' -- Electronic Arts/EA Maxis; PC; 2014. With over 175 million copies of 'The Sims' sold, EA Maxis enhances this simulation franchise with new technology, making it more lifelike. The franchise has evolved to incorporate more human behaviors. Each Sim now possesses a rich emotional core driving meaningful social interactions. Players can explore deeper stories with these more human simulations. Gameplay focuses on life's tragedies and triumphs, with customizable elements from Sims' homes to their aspirations. The core mechanics have endured for over a decade, with new content and gameplay added through expansions and sequels. 'Dead Island Epidemic' -- Deep Silver/Stunlock Studios; PC; TBD. Developer Stunlock Studios expands Techland's popular zombie franchise with this free-to-play PC MOBA game, stranding players on a zombie-infested tropical island. Three teams of four players compete for control of strategic positions while facing various zombies and undead creatures. Players can customize weapons from collected items, creating a unique action experience. This game distinguishes itself in the crowded MOBA genre with its blend of zombies and over-the-top action. 'Fable Legends' -- Microsoft/Lionhead Studios; Xbox One; TBD. Lionhead Studios returns to Albion with this Xbox One-exclusive adventure. Up to four players can embark on quests together, building characters and exploring photorealistic lands. The game supports seamless solo play and allows players to become villains with minions. The Xbox Smartglass feature enables villains to battle heroes on a second screen using tablets. 'The Order: 1886' -- Sony/Ready at Dawn; PlayStation 4; TBD. This unique next-gen action game presents an alternate Victorian-era London. Players join an elite order of knights in a centuries-old battle between good and evil. Blending historical elements with myths, the game features advanced weaponry for fighting supernatural enemies. The cinematic experience replicates the texture of film, with a foreboding atmosphere and action-heavy gameplay.

Ang core mechanics ay tumagal ng higit sa isang dekada, may bagong content at gameplay na idinagdag sa pamamagitan ng expansions at sequels. 'Dead Island Epidemic' -- Deep Silver/Stunlock Studios; PC; TBD. Tatlong koponan ng apat na manlalaro ay maglalaban para sa control ng strategic positions habang harapin ang iba't ibang mga zombie at undead creatures. Maaaring i-customize ng mga manlalaro ang kanilang mga sandata mula sa mga item na nakolekta, lumikha ng isang unikong action experience. Ang larong ito ay nagkakaisa sa siksikang MOBA genre ('Dota 2,' 'League of Legends,' 'Heroes of Newerth,' 'Infinite Crisis') sa kanyang kombinasyon ng mga zombie at over-the-top action. 'Fable Legends' -- Microsoft/Lionhead Studios; Xbox One; TBD. Ang Lionhead Studios ay bumabalik sa Albion sa Xbox One-exclusive adventure na ito. Hanggang apat na manlalaro ang maaaring magsimula ng mga quests magkasama, gumawa ng mga characters, at tuklasin ang photorealistic lands. Ang laro ay sumusuporta sa seamless solo play at nagpapahintulot sa mga manlalaro na maging mga villain na may mga minions. Ang Xbox Smartglass feature ay nagpapahintulot sa mga villain na labanan ang mga heroes sa pangalawang screen gamit ang tablets. 'The Order: 1886' -- Sony/Ready at Dawn; PlayStation 4; TBD. Ang unikong next-gen action game na ito ay nagpapakita ng isang alternatibong Victorian-era London. Sumasali ang mga manlalaro sa isang elite order ng mga knights sa isang century-old battle sa pagitan ng good at evil. Naghahalo ang laro ng historical elements sa mga myths, na may advanced weaponry para sa paglaban sa supernatural enemies. Ang cinematic experience ay nagmomonitor ng texture ng film, may foreboding atmosphere at action-heavy gameplay.
